mediaBrief.imagePrompt: Candid smartphone snapshot, slight tilt, natural color balance, neutral white balance. A phone snapshot taken from a low angle, slightly tilted, with flash glare on the screen. The image shows a nursing home building at night, partially obscured by dark smoke rising from the roof and one side wall. Emergency lights from fire trucks and police vehicles flash red and blue across the facade, casting moving reflections on wet pavement. A distorted, digitally overlaid text dominates the upper right corner of the frame, partially covering the building's sign. The background is blurred with motion and light trails, suggesting chaos. The phones hand gripping the device. The scene is tense and urgent, lit by emergency glow and ambient city night. text, or branding on the building or vehicles. Setting: a suburban residential street with a gas utility service truck, a technician in a hard hat holding a gas detector at a house meter, neighbors on the sidewalk, daylight
